title: Mojtaba Khamenei Orders Response Without 'Geographic Limits' to New Threats; Army Warns New US Attack Would Widen War
detail: Aggregated headlines report Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei ordered a military response without 'geographic limits' to new threats, while Iran's army warned any new US attack would spread the war wider. Headline-level reporting; details not independently confirmed.

title: Iran FM Calls US Outreach a 'Positive Step' as Iranian Delegation Arrives in Qatar for Talks
detail: Iran's foreign minister described US outreach as a 'positive step' as an Iranian delegation arrived in Qatar for talks, per Al Jazeera. Headline-level summary; details of the agenda not yet confirmed.
